Package com.github.crittscott.somestacks.gametest

Class CapabilityAndPersistenceChecks

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.gametest.CapabilityAndPersistenceChecks
public final class CapabilityAndPersistenceChecks extends Object
Disk persistence, client update tags and their validation, set-aside recovery, structure rotation, and cached-shape invalidation. The automation-surface half (whole-run capability/Transfer-API presence and headroom) stays in each loader's own CapabilityAndPersistenceGameTests, since it addresses the loader-native storage view directly.

  • Method Details

    • storageDiskSaveRoundTripsItemsRotationAndPermanence

      public static void storageDiskSaveRoundTripsItemsRotationAndPermanence(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Storage disk data preserves items, tags, block-state rotation, and permanence. To reproduce in-game: deposit tagged stone, rotate the block with a redstone torch, make the pile permanent, then save and restart the world. Verify the stone and its tag by extraction, the layout by observation, and permanence by emptying the pile and checking that it remains.

    • singlesDiskSaveRoundTripsItemsAndBothRotations

      public static void singlesDiskSaveRoundTripsItemsAndBothRotations(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Singles disk data preserves contents plus block-state and per-item rotations. To reproduce in-game: build a supported apple cell, rotate the block twice with a redstone torch and the apple three times with a soul torch, then save and restart the world. Both orientations and the item remain unchanged.

    • barDiskSaveRoundTripsItems

      public static void barDiskSaveRoundTripsItems(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Bar disk data preserves the item in each position. To reproduce in-game: deposit Bars, save and restart the world, and verify the same Bar positions remain occupied.

    • updateTagsCarryRenderStateAndOmitServerOnlyData

      public static void updateTagsCarryRenderStateAndOmitServerOnlyData(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Client update tags carry every field the renderers need while omitting server-only state. To reproduce the visible portion in-game: deposit into all three types, rotate Storage and Singles, and join with another client. Contents and rotations appear. Verifying omission of Permanent and Items.SetAside requires inspecting the update tags; no purely in-game reproduction proves those fields are absent.

    • unreadableSavedItemsAreKeptAsideOnDisk

      public static void unreadableSavedItemsAreKeptAsideOnDisk(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Unreadable and unplaceable saved entries remain unchanged in disk data and never enter a live slot. To reproduce in-game: deposit an item from another mod, quit, remove that mod, open and save the world, then restore the mod and open the world again. The item returns instead of having been discarded, and while the mod is absent the server log names the stack's position.

    • setAsideItemsRecoverIntoFreeSlots

      public static void setAsideItemsRecoverIntoFreeSlots(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Set-aside entries recover only into free valid slots and then leave the retained disk data. To reproduce recovery in-game: deposit an item from another mod, quit, open and save the world with that mod absent, then restore the mod and open the world. The item returns. Occupied-slot and invalid-slot retention require inspecting the saved tag.

    • clientUpdatesRejectMalformedDataAtomically

      public static void clientUpdatesRejectMalformedDataAtomically(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      A client update replaces local contents only when the whole tag is valid. No in-game reproduction applies: a well-behaved server never sends a malformed update.

    • clientSinglesUpdatesValidateRotationBeforeInventory

      public static void clientSinglesUpdatesValidateRotationBeforeInventory(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Malformed Singles item-rotation metadata invalidates the entire update. No in-game reproduction applies: a well-behaved server never sends one.

    • structureRotationTransformsRotatableStackFacing

      public static void structureRotationTransformsRotatableStackFacing(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Structure rotation and mirroring transform the facing of Storage and Singles, and the layout follows the facing. To reproduce in-game: save a Storage or Singles Stack holding several items in a structure block, then load the structure with a clockwise quarter turn or a mirror; the visible grid turns with the build.

    • cachedShapesInvalidateWhenContentsChange

      public static void cachedShapesInvalidateWhenContentsChange(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Internal cache check: query empty Singles and Bar shapes, directly insert into bottom slot 0, then extract again. Cached shapes become occupied and empty immediately.

      Nearest manual check: create each type with one item and check collision around its occupied position; after extraction no stale occupied collision should remain. Empty blocks may be removed, so direct cache identity is not observable.
